learning_outcomes.text: Determines the basic concepts in the analysis of power cycles.
Solves basic problems related to gas-vapor mixtures and air conditioning.

syllabus_topics: GAS POWER CYCLES: Basic concepts related to the analysis of power cycles, Carnot cycle, air standard assumptions and basic definitions related to reciprocating engines.
Otto, Diesel, Combined, Stirling and Ericsson cycles.
Brayton cycle, Brayton cycle with regenerator.
Brayton cycle with intercooling, reheating and regenerator, ideal reactive cycles.
Rankine cycle with reheat and regenerative feedwater heaters.
Dual vapor cycles, combined gas-vapor power generation.
REFRIGERATION CYCLES: Refrigeration machines and heat pumps.
Ideal and actual vapor-compression refrigeration cycles.
Ideal and actual vapor-compression refrigeration cycles.
Gas-powered, absorption refrigeration cycles and thermoelectric power generation and cooling systems.
Gas mixtures (Dalton's and Amagat's laws). GAS-VAPOR MIXTURES AND AIR CONDITIONING: Specific humidity, relative humidity, dew point temperature of air.
Adiabatic saturation and wet-bulb temperature, psychrometric diagram.
assessment_rules: In-term success (Yıl İçinin Başarıya) contributes 50% and the final exam contributes 50% to the overall grade. Within the in-term success, quizzes contribute 20% and the midterm exam contributes 80%.
bibliography: Fundamentals of Thermodynamics Richard Edwin. Sonntag, Claus Borgnakke, Gordon J. Van Wylen
